Subject: Exhibit B repricing request & SOW clause clarification

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement reviewed the draft order form and Exhibit B and asked for two items before legal will move to signature: 1) a clarified SOW clause around data retention and export for model telemetry, and 2) a repricing of the additional capacity block (the +300K token block) — they want to push the unit price down by 18% given committed usage.

I'm attaching a marked copy of Exhibit B and the order form (see attachments). Could you confirm whether Redwood can accept the repriced block or propose an alternative (e.g., amortized credit / ramped pricing)? Also need a short sentence we can hand to Stornet legal clarifying telemetry retention and export rights.

Goal: get signed before the end of April.

Best,

Hi Elaine — thanks for the head's up and for the marked PDF. Looping in Karthik (pricing lead) and Laura (legal ops) to evaluate. Two quick things from my side:

- We can propose a ramped discount: 10% for months 1-3, 14% for months 4-6, 18% thereafter if committed volume is met. This reduces immediate margin impact and preserves a path to the 18% target.
- On telemetry, I'll ask legal for a one-sentence clarifier that limits telemetry retention to aggregated, non-identifiable metrics for optimization and provides a customer export within 30 days on request.

I'll get back with a redline suggestion by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Naomi
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Exhibit B repricing request & SOW clause clarification

Naomi / Laura — reviewed Stornet's redline. My read: the client is asking for a permanent unit price reduction on the extra 300K block. Options we should present internally (w/ recommended tradeoffs):

1) Accept partial reduction via ramped pricing (Naomi's suggestion) — preserves list pricing and incentivizes consumption. Impact: ~6% blended ARR hit year 1.
2) Keep list price, offer one-time onboarding credit applied across first 3 invoices equal to requested discount — preserves long-term unit economics but lowers near-term cash.
3) Accept straight repricing if Stornet extends committed volume by 20% or shifts to a 12-month prepay — requires exec buy-in.

I recommend option 1 or 2. Laura — can you draft the telemetry sentence and a short redline for Exhibit B that accommodates option 1? If legal needs to push for a prepay trigger for option 3, flag me.

-Marketing note: also check if Finance is okay with applying credit vs. rebasing list price.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T13:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit B repricing request & SOW clause clarification

Karthik / Naomi — draft language below for Stornet legal; I will also produce a tracked redline of Exhibit B this afternoon.

--- proposed telemetry clause (one sentence) ---
"Redwood Inference will retain telemetry data only as aggregated, non-identifying usage metrics for the purpose of service optimization. Customer data used for model inputs and outputs will not be retained beyond 30 days except as required for billing and fraud prevention; upon Customer request Redwood will provide an export of telemetry data within 30 days."

Notes: the sentence balances their ask while preserving our ops needs; if they press for full deletion rights we will need to escalate.

For pricing redline: I'll create two Exhibit B tracks — (A) ramped discount schedule (10/14/18) and (B) one-time invoice credit equal to 18% of the first billed extra block. We can attach both and let Stornet choose.

I'll circulate the tracked doc + a short comparison table and proposed sign path (DocuSign envelope + legal signoff required).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Attached is a scanned redline of Exhibit B with our minor edits; we can sign as soon as Redwood shares the tracked Exhibit B (option A) with the go-live tie, and the updated order form (reflecting the ramp schedule).

- I'll route final to Stornet legal for signature once we receive the tracked doc.
